message: Saw SV Solutions covers church installs across the country — curious what pixel pitch you're specifying for those spaces. We did a P2.5 project in a Korean wedding hall where refresh rate and color uniformity were the main concerns. Church sanctuaries feel similar. What's your go-to panel for that environment?

Saw you guys cover everything from outdoor billboards to video walls in Miami — that's a tough mix to source consistently. We've been working a lot on the rental/video wall side lately, just finished a P2.6 job with some tricky refresh rate requirements. How are you handling color matching between indoor and outdoor panels on the same project?
